mapper.sql: SELECT w.case_id,s.order_id,s.order_line_id,s.warehouse_id,s.outbound_id,s.tracking_number, w.warehouse_status,w.phase,s.status AS case_status,s.quantity AS requested_quantity, s.received_quantity,s.approved_quantity,s.approved_merchandise_amount AS approved_amount, s.currency,s.refund_number FROM return_exception_work_orders w JOIN line_after_sales s ON s.id=w.case_id
s.kind='RETURN' AND s.status='REVIEW_REQUIRED' AND s.refund_number IS NULL AND s.warehouse_return_status IN ('SHORT_RECEIVED','REJECTED','FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS case_id,s.order_id,s.merchant_id FROM line_after_sales s WHERE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM return_exception_work_orders w WHERE w.case_id=s.id) ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 50
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO return_exception_work_orders(case_id,warehouse_status) SELECT s.id,s.warehouse_return_status FROM line_after_sales s WHERE s.id=#{caseId} AND
mapper.select: SELECT FROM return_exception_actions WHERE case_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY created_at,request_id
mapper.update: UPDATE return_exception_work_orders SET phase=#{phase},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE case_id=#{caseId} AND phase IN ('OPEN','WAITING_EVIDENCE')
